Definition: from G3384 and G4172; a mother city, i.e. "metropolis":--chiefest city.
BiblicalUsage: This word never appears in any verse of the New Testament. Its only place in the Received Text is the subscription at the end of 1 Timothy, where Laodicea is called the chiefest city of Phrygia Pacatiana, so I cite no verse for it.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that honesty matters more than a forced verse: the word is a real Greek word for a mother city, but Scripture itself never uses it, and I will not pretend otherwise.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
